_doc: Per-character settings for generate.py; see docs/generative-portraits.md. Variant ids are files of the `dune-hd heads` dump: fNN = a frame the game lists, vNN = part group NN drawn over frame 0. method: rerender (default; shapes) or recolour (colours; 'over' = the frame it is drawn over, default the base). kind is a label for people (and for a future openness heuristic). mouths: settings for every mouth group without its own entry (var_prompt, negative, settings).

LETO._variants_doc: The game's lip-sync table for LETO is groups 22, 34, 35 (v22 is the rest face). Every mouth group (generate.py mouth_groups: the groups drawn where the lip-sync mouths are) takes "mouths": v34 and v35's open-mouth prompt and negative, approved 2026-10-16, so all mouths share one look and the teeth match.

JESS._doc: Her f00 was approved in look as made by hdgen.py's batch, so she keeps its prompt ('the subject as drawn') and the game's style layers ("style": true). Notes from the user on f00 (2026-10-16): 'make her mouth thinner'; hazelnut brown eyes, the same in every frame. They apply to every frame and talking group. Her mouths have no shared prompt (removed 2026-10-16 at the user's request): each follows the game's art. v22 and v23 show her teeth, so they leave out the thin-lips note ("drop"), ask for parted lips, and a mouth pass repaints the opening with her upper teeth (its box: her jaw's shadow changes too, and is larger). Softening less (2) left lines on her skin, so they keep her usual softening.
